notes: Cosmological early-Universe axion simulation (post-inflation PQ breaking). Main result is a determination of the axion mass giving correct DM density: m_a = 25.2 +/- 11.0 ueV, corresponding to f_a = (2.27 +/- 0.33)e11 GeV. This is a preferred value on the f_a-m_a plane, not a conventional coupling exclusion limit. Fig. 4 gives Omega_a vs f_a (5e14-1e15 GeV in their unphysical box units), but the physical result is the single f_a/m_a determination reported here.
